body:
Thanks for contributing to the .NET module. I read through the issue and it seems like you've looked a lot into this.

The PR https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105262 adds a preload hook to retrieve the assemblies directly from the APK, so it shouldn't load the assemblies from the cache directory. However, we're using `api_assemblies_dir`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/19bb18716ef08b811fec330cba4d35fbdb027bcc/modules/mono/mono_gd/gd_mono.cpp#L497-L498

As you found, we left the code for extracting assemblies to the cache directory. It seems this sets the `api_assemblies_dir` value to the cache path, defeating the purpose of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105262:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/19bb18716ef08b811fec330cba4d35fbdb027bcc/modules/mono/godotsharp_dirs.cpp#L206

At the time I was thinking leaving that code as-is would serve as a fallback, but it's taking precedence instead. That was an oversight on my part.

I think Android is the only platform where we were using the extracting mechanism, so we should consider removing it altogether. But I would have to confirm this, since a lot has changed since this code was introduced.

For the time being, your PR addresses the issue nicely.
